description: Intel NPU model pack v1 (Phase 4c D5/D9): ResNet-50 INT8 (classify), YOLOv8n INT8 (detect), ~1B-param LLM INT4 (llm). AMD and Qualcomm packs are separate and come later. 'version' is the per-model version directory in the served path; 'files' are bare names found under <source-root>/<vendor>/<workload>/<id>/.
